product_scope: Remove HAPI compatibility sources; preserve HHPI v1; deliver M0-M8/A1-P4/R1-R10, bounded reopen windows and profile-guided delivery efficiency; no paired RSI experiments.

concurrency.policy: Assign a complete user path to one child, including integration; root waits for completion/conflict events, not progress polling. Four available slots are a ceiling, not a target.

node_semantics.done: Declared output and scoped verification accepted; finish gates satisfied; component completion is not integrated product acceptance.
node_semantics.dependencies: Hard output dependencies only. Shared writes and shared environments are resource constraints, not invented functional edges.
node_semantics.new_files: Proposed locations, not implemented capabilities; adjust through coordinator and update ownership before writing.
node_semantics.manifest: X0 resolves exact retirement files; E1 resolves conditional extension files. Unresolved manifests forbid those writes; never authorize directory-wide deletion.
node_semantics.review: Each cross-layer slice saves an independent first pass from original goals, baseline and raw results before comparing implementation coverage. V3 reconciles those reviews and new findings.
node_semantics.verification: Each coding task includes small local checks. Before a check, reserve stable reads of relevant source/dependencies; full checks/release reserve a stable checkout against every product writer.
node_semantics.requirements: The 64 mapped requirements are a baseline, not an exhaustive oracle; goal-required discoveries extend the same record and affected nodes.
node_semantics.integration: I nodes require lifecycle/adjacent-feature results and review of critical assumptions; compiler, component and visible-test success alone cannot close user delivery.

G_EXT.condition: E1 confirms supported public composition, or the exact needed DSH package extension is already explicitly approved; otherwise only the upstream-writing portion waits.

G_DEVICE.condition: Actual supported phone/browser/IME and agent control are available; viewport simulation is insufficient.

G_PUSH.condition: Authorized isolated push environment, subscription and source event are available; no credentials in this plan.

G_DEVICE_BUDGET.condition: The device checks proposed in main plan section 8 have an applicable recorded rule/budget; reuse any existing authorization.

G_OWNER.condition: Old task writer admitted work and requests are reconciled and supported handoff or natural completion permits one new writer; conversion development can proceed earlier.

G_PTY_EXIT.condition: Exact supported attach exists, or old terminal has ended or been explicitly handled; never kill or replace to satisfy migration.

resource_policy.composition: Coordinator serializes shared entry points; tasks may use other slots for disjoint files.
resource_policy.installed-runtime: H1/I6/V1/V2 use a fixed installed build; publication cannot replace it during checks.
resource_policy.stable-checkout: V0/V4 and any full check pause all product writes; read-only analysis/document work may continue.
resource_policy.paths: Intersecting write sets, and a test read set intersecting active writes, cannot overlap. Add test/helper/config paths to the reservation before editing.

release_policy.incremental: After an integrated dependency-closed slice is usable, coordinator may freeze writes and invoke the existing full release once; do not chain check/test:release/deploy. Remaining scope stays open.
release_policy.early_acceptance: V1/V2 may run before retirement on a named build. Later affected changes invalidate their affected results; V4 requires final-version-applicable evidence.
release_policy.failure: A failed node remains incomplete; fix under the same scope and revalidate affected descendants. New required behavior adds nodes/edges; never erase scope to force DONE.
